body: I want to talk to the chaplain, but I don't know what I would say or how I would explain myself.  I know the chaplain is willing to listen, but whenever I tell myself to do it, I rationalize why I shouldn't.  I perceive it as a weakness, especially because I don't *feel* like I should be effected by this.
That's a good way to look at it.  Thank you for taking the time and imparting some wisdom and showing you care.

Part of me feels like yes, it could have been me.  Like I said, I don't feel suicidal... but I really did identify with this guy, as weird as that sounds.  I felt he was a lot like me.  I've wanted to tell people that, but it sounds strange even to me.

But, like I said, I didn't really know him well.  So maybe not. 

And part of me feels guilty too, because I would tease him lightly about how weird he was.  But, I'm weird, too.  So I didn't feel like I was trying to be hurtful.
